title: Under the Odaa
logline: A girl overlooked in her own home discovers her worth was never measured by how much she gives.
style_block: Cinematic illustrated realism, painterly but anatomically believable, rural Oromo highland setting, warm earth palette, deep natural greens, soft golden-hour light, emotionally restrained, no text, no watermark
character_block: Fictional Oromo girl about 11, one practical braided hairstyle, faded ochre cotton dress with a thin green border, bare feet, carries a small worn blue notebook

references.prompt: Character reference sheet of Fictional Oromo girl about 11, one practical braided hairstyle, faded ochre cotton dress with a thin green border, bare feet, carries a small worn blue notebook: front view, side view, back view, neutral background
Environment reference: a vast mature Odaa fig tree on a highland meadow at golden hour

end_card.text: Made with AI. A fictional story inspired by real life.

shots.reason: Introduce the Odaa and the seed: potential nobody notices.
shots.image_prompt: A tiny green seedling pushing out of a crack in dry earth at the foot of a huge old fig tree, wide low angle, centered subject
shots.motion_prompt: slow gentle push toward the seedling, leaves stir in light wind

narration.oro: Muka Odaa jalatti, sanyiin tokko callisee biqila.
narration.en: Beneath the Odaa tree, a seed quietly begins to grow.
narration.am: በኦዳ ዛፍ ሥር፣ አንድ ዘር በጸጥታ ማደግ ጀመረ።

shots.reason: Establish the girl and her longing, seen from behind to keep identity safe.
shots.image_prompt: the girl seen from behind sitting on a doorstep at dusk, looking toward a distant empty path, centered
shots.motion_prompt: slight breeze moves her dress, camera nearly static

narration.oro: Intalli tokko yeroo tokko, jaalala barbaaddi turte. Garuu mana keessatti, yeroo baay'ee hojii ishee qofa argan.
narration.en: There was once a girl who longed for love. But at home, people often noticed only the work she did.
narration.am: ፍቅርን የምትናፍቅ አንዲት ልጅ ነበረች። ግን በቤት ውስጥ ሰዎች የሚያዩት ሥራዋን ብቻ ነበር።

shots.reason: Unequal responsibility, told through hands only.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of a child's hands washing a smaller child's hair over a clay basin, warm light, no faces
shots.motion_prompt: water pours slowly, hands move gently

narration.oro: Ijoollee kaan kunuunsiti. Hojii mana keessaa baatti.
narration.en: She cared for the other children. She carried the household chores.
narration.am: ሌሎቹን ልጆች ትንከባከባለች። የቤቱን ሥራ ሁሉ ትሸከማለች።

shots.reason: Emotional absence shown through an empty doorway, not through violence.
shots.image_prompt: An empty doorway of a mud-walled house, a single stool, long late shadow on the floor, nobody in frame

narration.oro: Garuu eenyutu ishee gaafata, "Ati hoo akkam jirta?"
narration.en: But who ever asked her, "And how are you?"
narration.am: ግን «አንቺስ እንዴት ነሽ?» ብሎ የጠየቃት ማን ነበር?

shots.reason: Her private imagination: the notebook at night.
shots.image_prompt: the girl hands only, drawing patterns in a small blue notebook by oil-lamp light, night, warm glow

narration.oro: Halkan tokko tokko, yeroo namoonni hundi rafan, isheen kitaaba ishee bantee ni barreessiti. Yaadni ishee guddaa ture. Abjuun ishee immoo caalaatti guddaa ture.
narration.en: Some nights, when everyone slept, she opened her notebook and drew. Her imagination was vast. Her dreams were even bigger.
narration.am: አንዳንድ ሌሊት፣ ሁሉም ሲተኙ፣ ደብተሯን ከፍታ ትስል ነበር። ምናቧ ሰፊ ነበር። ሕልሟ ደግሞ የበለጠ ትልቅ ነበር።

shots.reason: At school her talent becomes visible.
shots.image_prompt: the girl at a wooden school desk, a raised hand, a teacher's hand holding out a marked paper, bright classroom, medium shot
shots.motion_prompt: paper is handed over, slight smile

narration.oro: Mana barumsaa keessatti, dandeettiin ishee ifa ba'e. Harka ishee keessatti, fakkiiwwan, halluuwwanii fi yaadawwan haaraan dhalatan.
narration.en: At school, her talent began to shine. In her hands, new pictures, colours and ideas came to life.
narration.am: በትምህርት ቤት ችሎታዋ ማብራት ጀመረ። በእጆቿ አዳዲስ ሥዕሎች፣ ቀለሞችና ሐሳቦች ሕያው ሆኑ።

shots.reason: Match the invisible growth of roots to the girl's growth.
shots.image_prompt: Cross-section view of Odaa roots spreading wide under warm soil, a thin line of water reaching them, painterly
shots.motion_prompt: roots glow subtly, slow downward drift

shots.reason: Childhood to adulthood: the same hands, older.
shots.image_prompt: Adult woman's hands, same ochre sleeve border, drawing in the worn blue notebook, same lamp, morning light now

narration.oro: Intalli sun guddatte. Garuu waan tokko baratte: nama biraa jaallachuun, of dagachuu jechuu miti.
narration.en: The girl grew up. But she learned something: loving others does not mean forgetting yourself.
narration.am: ልጅቷ አደገች። ግን አንድ ነገር ተማረች፦ ሌሎችን መውደድ ራስን መርሳት ማለት አይደለም።

shots.reason: She chooses to care for herself: motif reframed.
shots.image_prompt: Adult woman sitting in the shade of the Odaa, resting, cup of coffee in her own hands, seen from the side
shots.motion_prompt: leaves move in the shade, she exhales

narration.oro: Muka Odaa akkuma gaaddisa kennu, isheenis ofii ishee kunuunsuu baratte.
narration.en: Like the Odaa tree offering shade, she learned to care for herself, too.
narration.am: የኦዳ ዛፍ ጥላ እንደሚሰጥ ሁሉ፣ እሷም ራሷን መንከባከብን ተማረች።

shots.reason: Ending image and message: shelter, belonging, gentle washing of a child's hair under the canopy.
shots.image_prompt: Wide view of the mature Odaa canopy with a woman and a small child sitting beneath it, golden hour, centered
shots.motion_prompt: slow pull back revealing the full canopy

narration.oro: Gatiin ishee waan kennituun hin madaalamu. Isheen nama guutuu dha. Isheen kunuunsa, jaalalaafi kabaja argachuu qabdi.
narration.en: Her worth is not measured by what she gives. She is a whole person. She deserves care, love and respect.
narration.am: ዋጋዋ በምትሰጠው አይለካም። ሙሉ ሰው ናት። እንክብካቤ፣ ፍቅርና ክብር ይገባታል።
